public_metadata.title: One Supplier Can Shut Down Your Business 😱😳
public_metadata.description:
One missing input can stop an entire company. Aliko Dangote's refinery shows why every business must protect the supplier it cannot operate without—through ownership, a contract, or a real backup.

Educational business analysis, not investment advice. Source footage and synthetic narration require rights clearance before publication.

#BusinessStrategy #SupplyChain #Dangote

snapshot.evidence_source: User-supplied public YouTube URL inspected with yt-dlp; public AV1/Opus transcode downloaded temporarily for visual and speech-content lineage verification
snapshot.interpretation: The snapshot was taken 30 seconds after publication. The observed zero-view count is upload-state evidence only and is not a performance diagnosis.

artifact_identity_check.interpretation: The public upload preserves the complete narrative, final sentence and visual lineage, but it is a shorter retimed timeline rather than the exact 58.5-second local master timing. This is not a simple missing-tail case.
